# Welcome to the Create Woensdag Modpack, now version 2.0 with Aeronautics on NeoForge

## What is this Modpack?
This is the modpack for the Create Woensdag server. This modpack is based around Create with addons. It is aimed to provide a vanilla+ experience.

## What other mods are included?
This modpack uses Create and addons, Ribbits, Tom's storage, TRWT and more! These mods aim to enhance the storage options for your playthrough, introduce new ways to travel and build and some frogs to keep you comfort.

It is rounded out with some general performance and quality of life mods.

Create Addons:
Create Aeronautics (+ a bunch of Aeronatics addons) Create: Steam 'n' Rails, Create Deco, Create: Armor Trims, Create: Copycats+, Create Slice & Dice, Create Man of Many Planes (+Immersive Aircraft, +Man Of Many Planes), Create: Interiors, Create: High Pressure, Create Goggles, Create: Power Loader (Fabric), Netherracked, Create Jetpack and Create Railways Navigator, Create: Dreams & Desires, Create Contraption Terminals, Create Enchantment Industry Fabric & Create: Numismatics!

Server Only Mods:
Whitelistd.

Shaderpacks:
Complementary Shaders - Reimagined, Complementary Shaders - Unbound

Supported versions:
Neoforge 1.21.1
Fabric 1.20.1 (only for older versions)

Issues:
Report bugs & issues to the issue tracker.

You need the Modrinth App to use the modpack. No plans adding CurseForge support anytime.

Credits to [Not Awake Studios](https://modrinth.com/organization/NotAwakeStudios) for the initial inspiration.
